# CANDIDATE: ORB_VWAP_SLOPE_BREAK

**Filed:** 2026-09-10  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

An opening-range break accompanied by a positive VWAP slope shift signals sustained momentum. The VWAP slope condition filters for breakouts with institutional participation, while the 5/8 EMA ribbon confirms short-term bullish alignment. This aims to capture the strong directional moves seen on J's winner days while avoiding choppy false breakouts.

## Mechanism

Entry: Go long when price breaks above the opening-range high (ORH) AND the VWAP slope (current VWAP minus VWAP 5 bars ago) is positive > 0.02% of price AND the 5-EMA > 8-EMA (bullish ribbon). For short, break below OR-L with negative VWAP slope and 5-EMA < 8-EMA. Exit: Stop at the opposite OR boundary (ORL for longs, ORH for shorts) or at the most recent swing point; target at 2R or at a VWAP-extension level. Regime filter: only active during higher volatility (VIX > 18) within the first 60 min after market open.
